verdict.rationale: RudderStack's Compliance Toolkit says it can "block, mask, or encrypt PII before it gets downstream" (docs-63). Transformations written in JavaScript or Python let you filter and reshape event data in flight before it reaches destinations (docs-49, docs-57), which supports field-level filtering and custom hashing logic. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that PII rules can be scoped per destination, explicit hashing support (only encryption is named), in-depth docs beyond marketing-level claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
